outline: Product Innovation Strategy, is given from a practitioner’s viewpoints on how to deploy the concepts, knowledge, and experiences related to information and communication industry (ICT), Big Data (BDA) and Internet of Things (IoT) in Industry 4.0. This course is also designed to look into the opportunity on global business development, innovative solutions to the global economy trend, and the economic trend of industries to deploy the most competitive strategies.
schedule:
W1-Industry Trend-Industry 4.0, Big Data, IoT, etc.
W2-Industry 4.0-Innovation Strategy
W3-Business Network Development Ecosystem
W4-Value Chain Cooperation for Product Innovation Strategy(PIS)
W5-New Product Project Development
W6-PIS on People/Process/Profits
W7-Firm’s (Team’s) Core Competences
W8-Group Project Presentation
W9-*** Mid-term exam.
W10-Industry Trend Research & Analysis
W11-Business Innovation Development
W12-Ubiquitous Computing Technology
W13-Product Project Management & Business Development
W14-Risk Assessment on New Product Development & Project Management
W15-Competitive Strategies on Industrial Trends
W16-Industry 2019-2030
W17-Group Project Presentation
W18-*** Final Exam.
assessment: These assignments will involve a team project presentation and an individual presentation, which will be graded 30 % for the mid-term and 40% for the final exam. The remaining 30% of the total grade is for students’ attendance.
